name: Kasuga Aroe
source:
"The School's Popular Girl"

A high school girl one year younger than the protagonist. They attend the same academy. She has an easygoing, big-sister personality and is wildly popular with both boys and girls.

Her athleticism is exceptional—so much so that various sports clubs passionately request her as a guest player. Conversely, academics seem to be a bit of a struggle for her.

She's also a natural leader among the girls. She puts on a tough front and is prone to jealousy.

She has a tendency to drop kick others.
